## Purpose
A shadcn/ui primitive (new-york style): A date picker calendar (Calendar, CalendarDayButton) styled with the button variants.

## Responsibilities
- Wraps react-day-picker with the project's Tailwind token classes.
- Exports the parts listed under Purpose.
- 177 lines. It has no project-specific logic: it imports only `cn` from `@/lib/utils` and other `ui` primitives.

## Key elements
The exported components.

None.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond the underlying library's own state.

## Configuration
None. Colours come from the CSS tokens in `src/styles.css`.

- **Generated by:** the shadcn CLI, from `components.json`.
- **Used by:** the app's components and routes.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **It is stock shadcn code,** so regenerating it with `npx shadcn add calendar` gives an equivalent file.
- **Styles may differ slightly from upstream,** because the classes use this project's tokens.

## How to rebuild this file
Run `npx shadcn@latest add calendar` with this `components.json`, or copy the file.
